coaching.headline: Sparrow turned a losing early read into 11/5 with 24.8k objective damage, and from 24 minutes we won every fight that mattered.
coaching.team: The paper had four of our five lanes behind, and the early film agreed — bad trades at 7.2 and 16.5, Mini Prime lost at 18. The turn was fighting on our objectives: 3-2 at their outer tower at 18.7, 3-1 at our Fangtooth at 24.6, the 27-minute pick, and a 4-0 at our inhibitor at 31.6 — six won fights, four cashed into Fangtooth (14, 20, 25), Genesis, Orb (28) and Primal (31). The recurring leak the macro names three times (13.1, 16.5, 22.2): a winning offlane that stayed in lane while short-handed fights were lost. Full anti-heal discipline was there (5 items into Muriel's comp); the rotation discipline is next.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 18.7 teamfight (3-2 at their outer tower) and the 24.6 3-1 at our Fangtooth — the two wins that turned a losing map into the 28-minute Orb-plus-Genesis double.

perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Sparrow's 11/5 with 24.8k objective damage was the win condition executed — the 27-minute 2-0 pick alone bought the inner-tower push. The one priced death: 16.7, which preceded their Mini Prime at 18.1 and a tower. The lane read was Skylar's early; the Vanquisher spike at ~24 is where the film flips.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Shinbi won the offlane read and the macro tells the story three times over (13.1, 16.5, 22.2): alive, ahead, and absent while the team lost a short-handed fight — then present at 18.7, and that fight was won 3-2. The lesson is right there in the film's own before-and-after: shove the won lane and arrive.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s), Bayle Kingslayer (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Muriel. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 5 items of it.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
ourKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
ourKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
ourKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
ourKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes → Line Tempo wolves → Circle Rhythm shield → All-Kill! wolfpack ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Track and unleash All-Kill! in a grouped fight
ourKits.playAgainst: spread vs the wolfpack; she's squishy without her shield up

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Plasma Grenade → Hypercharge on-hit → Air Assault reposition → Atomiser ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Hypercharge and kite-shoot from Air Assault safety
enemyKits.passive: extra jump; kills cause corpse explosions
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline so she can free-fire airborne
enemyKits.playAgainst: CC her out of Air Assault; she's squishy on the ground

enemyKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
enemyKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

enemyKits.combo: Alacrity shield+AS → Consecrated Ground bubble → Reversal global save
enemyKits.winCondition: keep the carry alive with global shields and enable their damage
enemyKits.passive: abilities grant Sentinel to allies; on-hit bonus
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has no damage threat — dive her carry through the shields or pick her first

enemyKits.combo: Evade in → Barricade block → Spear of Nyr (execute <20%) → Coliseum ult arena
enemyKits.winCondition: trap a target in Coliseum and out-duel with stacked Gladiator
enemyKits.playWith: a team that joins him inside the Coliseum
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't fight him in his arena — disengage; burst through Barricade's window

enemyKits.combo: Skull Crusher gap-close → Dire Howl slow → Cursed Edge → Kingslayer knockback dash, Berserk at low HP
enemyKits.winCondition: engage, drop low into Berserk and out-brawl
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up while he commits the dive
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Berserk rewards low HP — burst him fully or disengage; anti-heal helps

zarus.loadout: Xyris (Furor + Cull the Weak), augment The Ascended, crest Saphir's Mantle
lines: Coliseum at top rank: 120s base, about 88.9s by the end (26% shorter) from 35 ability haste: Berserker's Axe 15, Augmentation 20.
Zarus dealt 23,905 hero damage, 25% of their team's, with +155 physical power from items.
Berserker's Axe (item): On Dashing or Leaping: Empower your next Basic Attack within 3s. Deal 50 (+40%) Damage. Slows by 55% for 1s.
Augmentation (item): On Ability Cast: Empower your next Basic Attack within 4s. Deal (+90% Base Physical Power) Damage On-Hit.
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.

Saphir's Mantle (crest): Increase your Size and Max Health by 10% for 6s. Deal 60 (+1.25%) Damage to nearby Heroes. After the duration, permanently increase your Max Health by 20% of the Damage dealt.
Xyris (Eternal): Deal 3% bonus damage, increased by 0.4% per 10 units killed, up to 400 units.
Cull the Weak (Eternal minor): Deal 7% bonus damage to Minions and Monsters, and restore 1% Missing Mana on unit kill.

Sustain: Salvation: On going below 30% Health: Gain a (+25%) Shield for 6s. Reduced to 50% Effectiveness for Ranged Heroes. Gain 10% Omnivamp for 6s.; Tainted Rounds: On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.; 15,810 healing recorded.
Toughness: +1055 health, +8 physical armor, +5 magical armor, +25% tenacity; took 41,497 damage, mitigated 32,964, died 3 times.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Berserker's Axe, Augmentation, Tainted Rounds.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Salvation, Tainted Rounds.
Countered? 1 of the 4 players Zarus killed built physical armor (Phase). Anti-heal on Phase, Renna, Sparrow, Shinbi, Khaimera. We killed Zarus 3 times.
Copy it? this 3-item core: 61.3% in 75 games, above the 54.8% of that hero-role's cores. Proven this patch: worth copying.

card.lesson: Coliseum came back about every 89s instead of 120s by the end (26% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.

skylar.loadout: Vermis (Serration + Breach), augment Assault MK-II , crest Pacifier
lines: Skylar dealt 21,506 hero damage, 22% of their team's, with +137 physical power from items.
Lightning Hawk (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Deal 40 (+20%) Damage. Slows by 20% for 0.75s.
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Pacifier (crest): Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health.
Vermis (Eternal): Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack on the same Enemy Hero within 2.5s deals 3% (+0.25% per Level) of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Serration (Eternal minor): Vermis also deals 3.5% of the target's Missing Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Breach (Eternal minor): Ultimate damage reduces an Enemy Hero's Physical Armor by 35% for 4s.

Sustain: 7% lifesteal; Tainted Rounds: On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.; 1,458 healing recorded.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 4 effects on one trigger: Plasma Blade, Lightning Hawk, Tainted Rounds, Vermis.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Tainted Rounds, Pacifier.
The Eternal was part of it: Vermis (Serration + Breach) sits on the same trigger as the items (every basic attack set off), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 1 of the 1 players Skylar killed built physical armor (Phase). Anti-heal on Phase, Renna, Sparrow, Shinbi, Khaimera. We killed Skylar 6 times.
Copy it? Vermis: 44.4% in 995 Skylar carry games, below the hero's 47.1%. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.

sparrow.loadout: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity), augment Endless Hunt, crest Pacifier
fedBy: Endless Hunt (augment): Takedowns reset Sparrow's Basic Ability Cooldowns and permanently grant 1 Physical Penetration.
lines: Lead story: Healed through fights. 160 healing a minute, more than 98% of Sparrow carry players this patch.
15 takedowns (11 kills, 4 assists) fed: Endless Hunt (augment).
Sparrow dealt 36,267 hero damage, 31% of their team's, with +247 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12, Demolisher ignores 25%; against Skylar (level 17 estimated: about 103 physical armor, 66 after penetration) and Muriel (level 17 estimated: about 110 physical armor, 71 after penetration) that is about 23% and 23% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Lightning Hawk (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Deal 40 (+20%) Damage. Slows by 20% for 0.75s.
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Scattershot (item): Upon successful On-Hit Attack: Summon 2 projectiles from the Target. These home towards the closest Enemies. Each deals (+40%) Damage. Applies On-Hit effects at 50% effectiveness.
Pacifier (crest): Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health.

Thraex (Eternal): Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).

Sustain: 7% lifesteal; Tainted Rounds: On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.; Savage Strikes: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.; 5,125 healing recorded.

Lesson: Sparrow's penetration cut through: Skylar took about 23% more physical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 17 (estimated) their armor was about 103, about 66 after 12 flat + 25% penetration).

Stack (Healing off the damage): 3 effects on one trigger: Tainted Rounds, Pacifier, Savage Strikes.
The Eternal was part of it: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity) sits on the same triggers as the items (every basic attack set off; healing off the damage), so the same hits paid out twice.

copy.text: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity): 49.5% in 2,930 Khaimera jungle games, below the hero's 51.7%; this 3-item core: 55.3% in 217 games, below the 56.8% of that hero-role's cores. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.
